rows.commentary: 14.2: Shree Charani lands this one on a length outside off, and Modester Mupachikwa steps up to defend it firmly towards the covers.
14.3: Shree Charani floats up a tempting delivery around off, which Modester Mupachikwa meets cleanly and drives down towards mid-off.
14.4: Shree Charani drops it a fraction short on off, prompting Modester Mupachikwa to knock it neatly into the infield ahead of cover.

14.5: Shree Charani strikes as Modester Mupachikwa charges down the track for a lofted drive, mistiming it completely into the air where Kranti Gaud settles underneath it at mid-off to claim the catch.
14.6: Shree Charani spears a quick delivery into leg stump, trapping Sharne Mayers on the pad as she attempts to flick, though the umpire rightly waves away the appeal with the ball sliding down.
15.1: Deepti Sharma loops this one up on off, and Beloved Biza simply pushes it solidly down towards mid-on.
15.2: Deepti Sharma tosses it on off, and Beloved Biza aggressively advances to convert it into a full toss, driving it firmly along the ground to mid-on.
15.3: Deepti Sharma loops it slower on middle and leg, safely nudged by Beloved Biza straight toward mid-wicket.
15.4: Deepti Sharma offers one up on middle, and Beloved Biza dances down the track, absolutely thumping it straight over the bowler's outstretched hand and away to the boundary.
15.5: Deepti Sharma delivers a quicker length ball onto the leg stump, which Beloved Biza whips away swiftly through square leg to pick up a single.
15.6: Deepti Sharma pushes a full and straight delivery onto off stump, and Sharne Mayers dead-bats it smoothly into the covers.
16.1: Shree Charani targets the toes with a full delivery, and Beloved Biza nicely tucks it away through square leg to rotate the strike.
16.2: Shree Charani floats one away from Sharne Mayers, who opens the face to steer it toward point.
16.3: Shree Charani floats it fuller through the air, and Sharne Mayers safely dead-bats it to the off side.
16.4: Sharne Mayers rocks back to carve width through cover, where Mandhana dives sharply to parry it away.
16.5: Shree Charani drifts it onto the pads, allowing Beloved Biza to clip a single through square leg.
16.6: Shree Charani arcs one in, Sharne Mayers slices it into the turf, and they scramble hard for three.
28.4: Sayali Satghare drops it on a good length outside off, and Beloved Biza answers with a sharp back-foot punch straight to cover.
28.5: Sayali Satghare delivers outside off, dabbed away as the runners scramble through amidst a flutter of hesitation, beating the throw home safely on the stretch.
28.6: Sayali Satghare pins a good-length delivery onto off-stump, comfortably defended into the off-side by Chiedza Dhururu.
29.1: Shree Charani floats a loopy offering outside off, safely smothered by Beloved Biza towards short cover.
29.2: Shree Charani lands one on a length around off, dead-bat defended off the back foot into the off-side by Beloved Biza.
29.3: Shree Charani offers width outside off with a short delivery, carved past point by Beloved Biza to collect a single.
29.4: Shree Charani strays down the leg-stump, allowing Chiedza Dhururu to drop low and top-edge a sweep past the unprotected fine leg boundary for four.
29.5: Shree Charani responds with a teasing tossed-up delivery outside off that grips and spins away, completely beating Chiedza Dhururu's outside edge.
29.6: Shree Charani pitches full outside off, crisply driven straight to the mid-off fielder by Chiedza Dhururu.
30.1: Deepti Sharma darts one in, neatly tucked away onto the on-side by Beloved Biza.
30.2: Deepti Sharma fires an off-break onto leg-stump, clipped smoothly off the pads into the on-side for a couple of runs.
30.3: Deepti Sharma loops a flighted delivery right on middle, dead-bat defended straight back to the bowler.
30.4: Deepti Sharma loops it up full outside off, and Beloved Biza calmly steps forward to dead-bat the delivery into the off side.
30.5: Beloved Biza dances down the pitch to drill Deepti Sharma through the covers, forcing a frantic chase and recovery save near the rope after a fielding error.
30.6: Chiedza Dhururu gets right behind the line and presents a straight bat to return the ball firmly back to Deepti Sharma.
31.1: Jintimani Kalita targets middle and leg from a good length, prompting Beloved Biza to push the ball down towards mid-on.
31.2: Jintimani Kalita draws the edge with late away-swing outside off, allowing Beloved Biza to steer a single past the point fielder.
31.3: Wide from Jintimani Kalita to Chiedza Dhururu.
31.3: Dot ball from Jintimani Kalita to Chiedza Dhururu.
